widgets_values: "Two LEGO figurines, depicting the iconic characters from the Marvel Comics universe, stand vigilantly in a desolate, post-apocalyptic cityscape. The first figurine, donning a black cat-shaped helmet, is positioned on the left side of the frame, its gaze fixed intently on its companion. The second figurine, clad in a red and black full-body suit, stands opposite, its yellow utility belt gleaming in the dim, overcast light. A sleek, black katana is strapped to the first figurine's back, while the second figurine bears a similar sword, albeit with a slightly different design. The two figurines are positioned along the rule of thirds line, their placement creating a sense of balance and symmetry within the frame. The camera angle is slightly low, casting a sense of foreboding and menace over the scene. The lighting, a mix of natural and artificial illumination, casts deep shadows across the figurines' faces, accentuating their rugged, battle-hardened features. In the background, the ruins of a once-great city stretch out, a testament to the devastation that has been wrought. The image is shot in a muted color palette, with the dominant colors being shades of grey, black, and red, which adds to the overall sense of desolation and despair. The effect is one of gritty realism, plunging the viewer into a world of high-stakes action and adventure."
